Working with **film-crew → seedance-25-director**.

Session note: this workspace isn't a git repo and has no NOTES.md, so I couldn't pull or check for open items. I didn't change any files, so there's no NOTES entry to add.

**Crew plan (compact, multi-shot)**
- **Director:** Three beats on the voice-over: the question, the book, the shelf. The child is seen only from behind or by their hands. That makes them stand for "every child" and means the picture never has to match the VO's lip movements. Three shots of about 5 s each. The pace is calm and warm, like a bedtime story, not a hard ad cut.
- **Design / costume:** A child's room at night with graphite walls and one warm lamp. The child is about 7 and wears a **red knitted sweater** (#D90429, the brand's only accent). The red carries from shot 1 to shot 2. In shot 3 the red becomes a **ribbon bookmark**. Everything else stays black, white or graphite, plus warm paper tones.
- **DP:** 35–50mm look, shallow depth of field. Cool blue moonlight in shot 1, warm tungsten lamp in shots 2–3. Key light from frame-left in every shot.
- **Editor:**
  - Cut 1→2 matches on the hand: a finger drawing on the window becomes a finger on the page.
  - Cut 2→3 is a hard cut timed exactly to the VO's "Maghakian Scripts" at 9.5 s.
  - Each 0.5 s VO gap lands on a cut.
- **Camera operator:**
  - Shot 1: slow push-in.
  - Shot 2: top-down push from the open book to the letters.
  - Shot 3: lateral track left→right that ends on a still frame with empty space for the title.
- **Sound:** The clip is generated with quiet room sounds only (glass squeak, page turn, room tone). No speech and no music. The recorded VO and the music go on in the edit.

**Assumptions**
- **VO is not uploaded to Seedance.** It might re-voice or change it. The shot cuts are timed to its timestamps instead, and the VO is laid in the edit.
- **Real Armenian letters are not rendered.** AI produces fake letterforms that Armenian readers will notice, so the page text stays out of focus.
- **The end title is an edit overlay.** "Maghakian Scripts / Books for ages 0–16", white on graphite, goes into the empty space the last shot leaves.

**Timeline**
- **0–4.5 s:** At night, a child at a frosted window draws a question mark in the fog. *(VO 1)*
- **4.5–9.5 s:** A book opens on the child's lap under a warm lamp. The camera pushes in to a finger tracing lines of Armenian text. *(VO 2)*
- **9.5–15 s:** The camera tracks along a shelf of books, from tiny board books to thick novels. It stops on a red bookmark, with empty wall above for the title. *(VO 3, then the title holds)*

**Risks**
- The question mark drawn in the fog may come out as a squiggle. If it does, regenerate once, or re-time shot 1 so the finger is still drawing as the cut lands.
- The shelf may not grow evenly from small to tall books. Check this in QC.
- If you want real Armenian text on the page, give me a scan of one of your own book spreads. I'll rewrite shot 2 to use it as @Image 1.

## FINAL

**Settings (Dreamina):** Seedance 2.5 · Omni Reference · Duration **15 s** · Ratio **9:16** · Resolution 720p (1080p if your plan offers it) · No uploads.

**Edit:** Put the recorded VO at 0.0 s. Add soft music under it. At about 10.5–15 s, put the title overlay in the empty upper part of the last shot: "Maghakian Scripts" / "Books for ages 0–16" (Armenian), white on graphite. The red ribbon is already in the frame as the accent.

```text
A 15-second vertical promo for an Armenian children's book publisher, three shots, warm bedtime-story realism, shallow depth of field, soft film grain. Palette: graphite, black and white with warm paper tones; the only saturated colour is one deep red (#D90429). The child is never seen from the front: only from behind, in silhouette, or as hands.

Locked continuity: a child about seven years old, short dark hair, wearing a deep red knitted sweater with slightly long sleeves; a quiet child's bedroom at night with matte graphite walls; key light always from frame-left.

[0-4.5s] Shot 1 — medium close-up from behind the child's right shoulder, slow push-in. The child kneels on a window seat facing a dark window; cool blue moonlight from frame-left, a night sky with a few stars beyond the glass. The child breathes on the cold glass, a patch of fog forms, and one small finger slowly draws a large question mark in the fog. The shot ends with the finished question mark centred in frame, the red sweater sleeve at the bottom edge. Sound: soft room tone, a faint squeak of a fingertip on glass.

[4.5-9.5s] Shot 2 — hard cut, top-down view over the child's lap, warm tungsten lamp light from frame-left. The red sweater sleeves rest on an open hardcover picture book; both small hands lift the cover and the pages fall open to a spread with a soft watercolour illustration and lines of Armenian text. The camera pushes slowly down toward the page until a single fingertip fills the lower third, tracing along one line of text from left to right. The letters stay softly out of focus; the fingertip and paper texture are sharp. Sound: the cover opening, one gentle page turn, quiet room tone.

[9.5-15s] Shot 3 — hard cut, eye-level shot of a single long graphite wall shelf, slow lateral camera track from left to right. The books on the shelf grow in size along the track: small square board books with rounded corners at the far left, then thin picture books, then middle-grade chapter books, then thick tall novels at the right, spines in white, black and graphite. Warm lamp light from frame-left. The track slows and stops at 13s on the tallest novel, which has one deep red ribbon bookmark hanging down its spine; the camera then holds completely still to the end. The upper 40% of the frame is empty matte graphite wall, clean and unlit by any object. Sound: quiet room tone only.

Global: three shots joined by hard cuts at exactly 4.5s and 9.5s; key light from frame-left in every shot; the deep red appears only on the sweater and the ribbon bookmark. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no watermark, no background music, no voices, no speech, no singing, no narration. No child's face visible, no adults, no extra people, no toys or cartoon characters, no readable fake letters in focus, no camera shake, no colour other than graphite, black, white, warm paper tones and the single deep red.
```
